gospel.text: Does this theme solve a problem or fulfill a need that is so universal and urgent that it could rearrange the existing market structure? Most truly revolutionary paradigm shifts do one of two things: reduce suffering or increase connection.

gospel.text: It's not whether you're right or wrong; it's how much you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.

Warren Buffett, Carl Icahn, George Soros: they all only have one thing in common. And it's the exact opposite of what they teach in a business school. It is to make large, concentrated bets where they have a lot of conviction.
I follow the old Soros rule, invest and then investigate.
Soros used to say the crowd's right 80% of the time. You just can't be caught in the other 20% because you can get your head handed to you.
Size down when direction is not clear.
